symptom: `dataview (datasource: microflow M.DS_X(Param = ))` reported `line 3:19 no viable alternative at input 'datasource'` — the column of a correct keyword, 29 characters before the mistake
cause: ANTLR predicts a widget property with full-LL lookahead, so a failure anywhere inside the property is reported at its first token; moving the report needs a grammar restructure or a custom error strategy
insight: When ANTLR mis-locates an error inside a long alternation, a source-line diagnosis in the error enhancer is far cheaper than an error strategy: scan the flow call's argument list on the offending line, name the first malformed argument with its own line:column, and stay silent when every argument looks well formed (the error is then elsewhere). Note the listener prefixes `line N:C` AFTER enhancement, so the line has to be passed in (errorSite.line), not parsed from msg. A trailing comma `M.F(P = $v,)` parses with no error to the same AST, so it was left alone.
